The '''Catarlo sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], near the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] within Catarlo sector included [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]].

==History==
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Catarlo sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harlow]].<ref name="GNN11" />
